name: spark-alight-spellshroud-unit-is-not-a-legal-target
notes: Spark Alight: the opposing Aquamirage Whisper (printed spellshroud) is refused as the target and the Dungeon Guide is chosen instead. The spell builds its target list without its own spellshroud filter; the central filter in OnCardActivated removes the spellshroud unit.
